intent: Lead with a bold thesis in a hero band; support with three contrasting columns below.
invariants: hero band spans full grid width with accent bar on left edge
hero text is the largest/most prominent element (22pt Space Grotesk bold)
exactly 3 support cards below, equal width (4 cols each)
each support card has accent bar, kicker heading, body text
max 2 accent colors used (accent_1 for hero fill, accent_2 for card bars and kicker)
hero band has optional kicker text above the main statement
support cards use muted fill (accent_5) for background
vertical stacking: header bar, hero band, then card row
variables: optional kicker text above hero (e.g. 'OPERATING PRINCIPLE')
support heading casing (upper by default via kicker style)
support body text length (20-150 chars per card)
header bar kicker and title text
